preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is between 2 and 100.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: Number of paths is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(path) <= n - 1 for path in paths_description)
postconditions.description: Each path has between 1 and n-1 edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge <= n - 1 for path in paths_description for edge in path[1])
postconditions.description: Each edge in a path is within the range [1, n-1].

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for path in paths_description for u, v in path[2])
postconditions.description: Each point is placed on an edge connecting two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1 for path in paths_description for x in path[3])
postconditions.description: Distance x for each point is between 0 and 1.

postconditions.expression: all(any(u in path[1] for path in paths_description) for u in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Each vertex is part of at least one path.
